interface: Molex Micro-Lock Plus 2.0 wire-to-wire, single-row tin, 2 circuits

board_side.board_land: J4 legacy 2.00 mm PTH pair; NO JST header fitted
board_side.assembly: insert the factory pre-crimped female contacts into 5055700201 and retain the factory 75 mm pigtail/free-tip preparation for the first five; do NOT cut/re-strip/re-tin before the J4 fit check because that would void the drawing's free-tip diameter basis. Verify one exact factory tinned tip passes freely through an actual >=0.70 mm finished J4 barrel with no strand shaving or force, then solder from B.Cu and keep the front-side conductive profile <=0.50 mm. If shortening is ever required, the new stripped/tinned end becomes a new workmanship qualification and must re-pass diameter/free-fit/strand inspection before use.

strain_relief.process: after solder joints pass visual/profile inspection and cleaning, form a relaxed rear-side service loop and apply a non-flowing fillet over the insulated red/black pigtails onto clean B.Cu solder mask; begin the adhesive beyond the inspected solder fillets so joints remain inspectable, bond both insulated leads to the PCB for at least 8 mm of length, and do not allow cured adhesive, wire or hard solder-wick transition to bear on the LiPo pouch or coax
strain_relief.cure: AQROOT process: hold at room conditions for >=24 h before enclosure retention/closure testing; this is a conservative process hold, not a claim of full manufacturer cure. Adhesive must at minimum be tack-free and pass the finished harness retention inspection before use.
strain_relief.disconnect_instruction: release and grip the two Micro-Lock housings; never disconnect by pulling either wire bundle
strain_relief.service_loop: preserve >=35 mm free wire from each housing before tie/bundle per Molex product specification and leave enough relaxed board-side loop that mating force is not transferred into J4 solder barrels
strain_relief.primary_source_basis: Dow product page: one-part moisture RTV, non-flow, PWB/wired-lead use, room-temperature alkoxy/condensation/methoxy cure; tack-free 55 min at 50% RH.

battery_side.retermination: replace factory JST-PH housing/contacts with Micro-Lock Plus plug; one conductor at a time; preserve red=BAT+ and black=GND; measure insulation OD before stripping and reject/rework the connector plan if outside the terminal/tool range

controlling_rating.basis: 5055700003-PS A6 section 4.2; both sides are 26 AWG, so the mated harness rating is 2.6 A

acceptance: board side uses exact Molex factory pre-crimped leads 2175012101 red and 2175011101 black, 75 mm, 26 AWG UL 10002; no hand-crimped board-side contact
before soldering all five boards, verify the stripped conductor of one 217501 26 AWG lead passes freely through an actual finished J4 0.75 mm PTH without strand shaving or force

measure both battery lead insulation ODs on every incoming Adafruit 328 pack before retermination; terminal specification is 0.90-1.50 mm and the 213309-5900 tool IPC-optimum range is 0.96-1.50 mm; do not crimp an out-of-range lead
battery-side 2137201000 crimps use Molex 213309-5900 or an equivalently qualified production process and are visually inspected for conductor/insulation capture
minimum battery-side crimp pull-out: AWG26 19.6 N per Molex product/application tooling specification
verify cavity polarity with DMM before first mate and after every battery retermination

strain-relieve the board pigtail exactly per the frozen DOWSIL 3145 process above; maintain >=35 mm free wire from each housing before tie/bundle; disconnect by gripping/releasing housings only, never by pulling wires
front-side J4 conductor is trimmed flush and insulated under the display per the existing display-shadow rule
first article: run published worst-case concurrent Demo load and record connector/lead temperature rise; target <30 C rise
design_intent: Restores full internal RF/NFC/IR availability with both accessory rails enabled; no protected battery copper moved. Factory pre-crimped board leads remove a first-five hand-crimp variable.
